reviews.comment:
Paramos en la ypf para cargar nafta y de paso comprar agua .... Salimos corriendo y casi vomitando del olor asqueroso e indescriptible a baño público que había dentro del local de la estación.. creo que el baño estaba en mejor estado .. me sorprendió igual la gente consumiendo en el local ya sea un café o una hamburguesa.. o se les perdió el olfato con la pandemia del COVID o no encontraba explicación.. lamentablemente el estado

(Translated by Google)
We stopped at the YPF gas station to fill up and buy some water... We ran out, almost vomiting from the disgusting, indescribable smell of a public restroom inside the station's shop. I think the restroom was in better condition. I was still surprised to see people eating or drinking in the shop, whether it was coffee or a hamburger. Either they lost their sense of smell during the COVID pandemic, or I couldn't find any other explanation. Unfortunately, the state of the station...
